title: The Golden Box Comes Home
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
God's people had a golden box,
The Ark, so bright and grand.
It showed that God was with them all,
And kept them in His hand.

[Chorus]
The Lord is stronger than the dark,
And stronger than your fears.
So when you're scared, just say a prayer,
And He will dry your tears.

[Verse 2]
The enemies took it away,
But bad things happened there.
Their statue fell, and they were scared,
They sent it home with care.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes, no need to fear,
Sleep safely through the night.
The Lord who brought the Ark back home
Will hold you in His might.

[Chorus]
mood: Strong music. A broad, slow pulse moves under the voice with quiet weight, like a procession bringing something precious home, steady and unafraid. The first verses carry a sense of solid ground beneath the melody, calm strength rather than drama. By the last verse the pulse slows and settles lower, easing from a march into a gentle, protective stillness over the bed.
